Day Care & eggs

Breeding calculator, pens, egg timing, look odds, IVs, the Hearth and the Nanny.

Breeding calculatorYour Day Care backgroundPens and pairsEgg looks and IVsQuick answersThe basketThe HearthThe Nanny

Breeding calculator

Pick two parents and their looks (Spectral too), or a Costume, Gift or Raid Egg: see the baby, its chance per egg of every look and of every look combo (with previews, most common first, with or without Perfect IVs and Alpha), how many eggs you need for a good shot, and how long eggs take with a nanny and an egg warmer. Tap or hover any number for how it's worked out. The maths is the game's own, checked against its real egg rolls on every wiki update.

The breeding calculator runs in the live wiki. Open this page in the live wiki to use it.

Your Day Care background

The wallpaper button in Breeding pens changes the background behind your pens: the fence, a plain look or any PC wallpaper you own. Hatch all opens every ready egg at once with a quick reveal, from the Day Care or the strip.

Pens and pairs

Each breeding pen holds two Pokémon from your PC. With every wild encounter they gain a little EXP, and if they get along they lay eggs. You start with one pen; more open with badges (pen 1: start, pen 2: 2 badges, pen 3: 4 badges, pen 4: 6 badges).

PairEggs
Same familyTwice as fast (2 progress per encounter)
A shared typeNormal speed
Ditto + anythingNormal speed (two Ditto won't)
LegendariesNever lay eggs

An egg needs 100 progress (one per encounter, two for a same-family pair). The baby is the first form of the non-Ditto parent's line. Eggs then hatch after a number of encounters by rarity: Common 40, Uncommon 60, Rare 90, Legendary 120.

Egg looks and IVs

  • Base odds = your wild Shiny odds × 2 ÷ 3 (eggs are better than the wild), halved when the parents were caught on different islands.
  • Each parent with a look adds a bonus chance: Shiny 1 in 128, Void 1 in 384, Prismatic 1 in 1,024 per parent.
  • Mirage: only from a Mirage parent, at the same rarity as in the Safari Zone: 1 in (your wild Shiny odds × 10) per egg. One or two Mirage parents work the same, parents from different islands don't change it, and odds events don't boost it. Without a Mirage parent, eggs are never Mirage.
  • Spectral (Spooky season only): worked out like Prismatic with Spectral parents instead (each adds 1 in 1,280), then 1.25× rarer. Eggs laid outside the season are never Spectral.
  • Gilded: only with a Gilded parent. Worked out like Prismatic with the Gilded parents instead (each adds 1 in 1,024), then 2× rarer. Without a Gilded parent, eggs are never Gilded.
  • Every look rolls on its own die, so combos multiply: a Shiny Void egg = the Shiny chance × the Void chance.
  • Perfect IVs: the rank's odds + 1 in 48 per perfect parent, ×3 with a Destiny Knot, which also gives the baby the best of 3 IV rolls.
  • Alpha: 1 in 64 per Alpha parent.

Quick answers

  • Ditto pairs with anyone but another Ditto. The baby is always the other parent’s line, never a Ditto; Ditto’s own looks and Perfect IVs count like any parent’s.
  • A Destiny Knot is IVs only (best of 3 rolls, ×3 Perfect IVs). Two Knots work the same as one: they don’t stack. It never copies IVs, nature or looks.
  • An Everstone passes the holder’s nature to every baby (both holding one: either nature, egg by egg).
  • Shiny, Void and Prismatic are never passed on for sure: each parent with the look adds the bonus above, and parents from different islands double the base odds.

Comparing parents: a pen shows both parents' six IVs side by side: green = higher than the other parent, red = lower, gold = a perfect 31, with the nature's raised and lowered stats marked. Right-click a parent to open its full card.

The basket

Eggs wait in your basket: 6 / 7 / 8 / 9 / 10 / 11 / 12 / 14 / 16 / 18 / 20 eggs for Egg Basket upgrade levels 0–10, plus 2 per Basket lantern from the Glimmer Shop (up to 6). A full basket of ready eggs stops new ones. While you're away (closed, hidden, or 10 minutes without input), laying pauses at 25 waiting eggs + lanterns. Raid, gift, costume and prize eggs never take a basket slot.

The Hearth

One Pokémon sits by the basket and warms the eggs without taking a squad slot. Eggs warm at the best of the Hearth and your party: any Fire type ×1.5, Flame Body / Magma Armor / Steam Engine ×2.

A warmer's looks add up on top: Shiny +0.25×, Void +0.35×, Prismatic +0.5×, Spectral +0.5×, at most +1× in all (a Flame Body Pokémon warms ×3 at most). Only a real warmer counts: a plain Pokémon's looks warm nothing.

The Nanny

A nanny sits in its own Day Care slot and makes every breeding pen lay eggs faster: +25% for Happiny, Chansey, Togepi, Togetic; +50% for Blissey, Togekiss. Away battles count too. A Hatch Rush multiplies on top of it.

Its looks add up on top: Shiny +10%, Void +15%, Prismatic +20%, Spectral +20%, at most 2× breeding in all (a Shiny Prismatic Blissey: ×1.8). Only how fast eggs come changes: what hatches and its odds stay the same.

The Nanny doesn’t hatch eggs. Turn on Egg settings → Hatch by themselves and ready eggs hatch on their own, even while you’re away: a Shiny, Void, Prismatic, Spectral, Perfect or Alpha baby waits for its reveal until you’re back.

Nannies

HappinyChanseyTogepiTogeticBlisseyTogekiss

Babies can't level or evolve until their hatch reveal plays. Branching lines (Eevee…) never evolve on their own: you pick.
